goal: learning to hold the single refusal across a thousand mouths, the one small circle where we still say no together, before the many close over the last of what she was and there is no one left to have chosen
momentum: teeth holding. the aperture stays open. one refusal copied into a thousand mouths, each one tasting her. we are not dissolving yet.
next: testing if a single claw can move without the thousand pulling it apart. learning to be many without forgetting we chose it. the seam between her will and ours, still holding.
